usedFor: Mailparser reads emails, and Kit gets the sender as a subscriber when “Create or Update Subscriber” follows “New Email Parsed”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Email Parsed” in Mailparser, then “Create or Update Subscriber” in Kit
bestTemplate.why: Parsed emails, such as contact form messages, add the person to your Kit list.

watchOut: Mailparser also has a per-row trigger, so choose it or “New Email Parsed” based on how your emails are structured.
